verses.original: δέ τις Λάζαρος Ἦν ἀσθενῶν ἀπὸ Βηθανίας ἐκ τῆς κώμης Μαρίας καὶ αὐτῆς τῆς ἀδελφῆς Μάρθας
verses.transliteration: de tis Lazaros Ēn asthenōn apo Bēthanias ek tēs kōmēs Marias kai autēs tēs adelphēs Marthas
verses.literal: At this time a [man] [named] Lazarus was sick [He lived in] Bethany - the village of Mary and her - sister Martha

verses.original: δὲ Μαριὰμ ἧς ὁ ἀδελφὸς Λάζαρος ἠσθένει ἦν ἡ ἀλείψασα τὸν Κύριον μύρῳ καὶ ἐκμάξασα αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας ταῖς αὐτῆς θριξὶν
verses.transliteration: de Mariam hēs ho adelphos Lazaros ēsthenei ēn hē aleipsasa ton Kyrion myrō kai ekmaxasa autou tous podas tais autēs thrixin
verses.literal: ( - Mary whose - brother Lazarus was sick was - to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His - feet with her hair

verses.original: οὖν αἱ ἀδελφαὶ ἀπέστειλαν λέγουσαι πρὸς αὐτὸν Κύριε ἴδε ὃν φιλεῖς ἀσθενεῖ
verses.transliteration: oun hai adelphai apesteilan legousai pros auton Kyrie ide hon phileis asthenei
verses.literal: So the sisters sent word to [Jesus] Lord . . . the [one] You love is sick

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀκούσας εἶπεν Αὕτη ἡ ἀσθένεια ἔστιν οὐκ πρὸς θάνατον ἀλλ’ ὑπὲρ τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ δοξασθῇ δι’ αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Akousas eipen Hautē hē astheneia estin ouk pros thanaton all’ hyper tēs doxēs tou Theou hina ho Huios tou Theou doxasthē di’ autēs
verses.literal: [When] - Jesus heard [this] He said This - sickness will not end in death No [it is] for the glory - of God so that the Son - of God may be glorified through it

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἠγάπα τὴν Μάρθαν καὶ αὐτῆς τὴν ἀδελφὴν καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Ēgapa tēn Marthan kai autēs tēn adelphēn kai ton Lazaron
verses.literal: Now - Jesus loved - Martha and her - sister and - Lazarus

verses.original: οὖν ὡς ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἀσθενεῖ τότε μὲν ἔμεινεν ἐν τόπῳ ᾧ ἦν δύο ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: oun hōs ēkousen hoti asthenei tote men emeinen en topō hō ēn dyo hēmeras
verses.literal: So on hearing that [Lazarus] was sick - - He stayed vvv vvv where He was for two days

verses.original: ἔπειτα μετὰ τοῦτο λέγει τοῖς μαθηταῖς Ἄγωμεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Ἰουδαίαν
verses.transliteration: epeita meta touto legei tois mathētais Agōmen palin eis tēn Ioudaian
verses.literal: and then . . . . . . He said to the disciples Let us go back to - Judea

verses.original: Ῥαββί οἱ μαθηταί Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι νῦν ἐζήτουν λιθάσαι σε καὶ ὑπάγεις πάλιν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Rhabbi hoi mathētai Legousin autō hoi Ioudaioi nyn ezētoun lithasai se kai hypageis palin ekei
verses.literal: Rabbi - [they] replied - the Jews just tried to stone You and You are going back there

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη εἰσιν Οὐχὶ δώδεκα ὧραί τῆς ἡμέρας ἐάν τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ οὐ προσκόπτει ὅτι βλέπει τὸ φῶς τούτου τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Apekrithē eisin Ouchi dōdeka hōrai tēs hēmeras ean tis peripatē en tē hēmera ou proskoptei hoti blepei to phōs toutou tou kosmou
verses.literal: Jesus answered Are there not twelve hours of daylight If anyone walks in the daytime vvv he will not stumble because he sees by the light of this - world

verses.original: δέ ἐὰν τις περιπατῇ ἐν τῇ νυκτί προσκόπτει ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἔστιν οὐκ τὸ φῶς
verses.transliteration: de ean tis peripatē en tē nykti proskoptei hoti en autō estin ouk to phōs
verses.literal: But if anyone walks at - night he will stumble because - he has no - light

verses.original: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο εἶπεν Ταῦτα λέγει αὐτοῖς ἡμῶν ὁ φίλος Λάζαρος κεκοίμηται ἀλλὰ πορεύομαι ἵνα ἐξυπνίσω αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai meta touto eipen Tauta legei autois hēmōn ho philos Lazaros kekoimētai alla poreuomai hina exypnisō auton
verses.literal: - After - He had said this He told them Our - friend Lazarus has fallen asleep but I am going [there] to wake him up . . .

verses.original: οὖν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταὶ Εἶπαν Κύριε εἰ κεκοίμηται σωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: oun autō hoi mathētai Eipan Kyrie ei kekoimētai sōthēsetai
verses.literal: - His - disciples replied Lord if he is sleeping he will get better

verses.original: δὲ ἐκεῖνοι ἔδοξαν ὅτι λέγει περὶ τῆς κοιμήσεως τοῦ ὕπνου δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰρήκει περὶ τοῦ θανάτου αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ekeinoi edoxan hoti legei peri tēs koimēseōs tou hypnou de ho Iēsous eirēkei peri tou thanatou autou
verses.literal: - They thought that [Jesus] was talking about - actual sleep . . . . . . but - [He] was speaking about the death of [Lazarus]

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τότε εἶπεν αὐτοῖς παρρησίᾳ Λάζαρος ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous Tote eipen autois parrēsia Lazaros apethanen
verses.literal: So - Jesus - told them plainly Lazarus is dead

verses.original: καὶ δι’ ὑμᾶς χαίρω ὅτι ἤμην οὐκ ἐκεῖ ἵνα πιστεύσητε ἀλλὰ ἄγωμεν πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai di’ hymas chairō hoti ēmēn ouk ekei hina pisteusēte alla agōmen pros auton
verses.literal: and for your sake . . . I am glad - I was not there so that you may believe But let us go to him

verses.original: οὖν Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος Εἶπεν τοῖς συμμαθηταῖς ἡμεῖς καὶ Ἄγωμεν ἵνα ἀποθάνωμεν μετ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun Thōmas ho legomenos Didymos Eipen tois symmathētais hēmeis kai Agōmen hina apothanōmen met’ autou
verses.literal: Then Thomas - called Didymus said to [his] fellow disciples {Let} us also go so that we may die with Him

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐλθὼν εὗρεν αὐτὸν ἔχοντα ἤδη τέσσαρας ἡμέρας ἐν τῷ μνημείῳ
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous Elthōn heuren auton echonta ēdē tessaras hēmeras en tō mnēmeiō
verses.literal: [When] - Jesus arrived He found that [Lazarus] had already spent . . . four days in the tomb

verses.original: δὲ ἡ Βηθανία ἦν ἐγγὺς τῶν Ἱεροσολύμων ὡς δεκαπέντε σταδίων ἀπὸ
verses.transliteration: de hē Bēthania ēn engys tōn Hierosolymōn hōs dekapente stadiōn apo
verses.literal: Now - Bethany was near - Jerusalem a little less than two miles . . . away

verses.original: δὲ πολλοὶ ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐληλύθεισαν πρὸς τὴν Μάρθαν καὶ Μαριὰμ ἵνα παραμυθήσωνται αὐτὰς περὶ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ
verses.transliteration: de polloi ek tōn Ioudaiōn elēlytheisan pros tēn Marthan kai Mariam hina paramythēsōntai autas peri tou adelphou
verses.literal: and many of the Jews had come to - Martha and Mary to console them in the loss of [their] brother

verses.original: οὖν ὡς ἡ Μάρθα ἤκουσεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἔρχεται ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ δὲ Μαριὰμ ἐκαθέζετο ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ
verses.transliteration: oun hōs hē Martha ēkousen hoti Iēsous erchetai hypēntēsen autō de Mariam ekathezeto en tō oikō
verses.literal: So when - Martha heard that Jesus was coming she went out to meet Him but Mary stayed at - home

verses.original: οὖν ἡ Μάρθα Εἶπεν πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν Κύριε εἰ ἦς ὧδε μου ὁ ἀδελφός ἂν οὐκ ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: oun hē Martha Eipen pros ton Iēsoun Kyrie ei ēs hōde mou ho adelphos an ouk apethanen
verses.literal: - - Martha said to - Jesus Lord if You had been here my - brother vvv vvv would not have died

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καὶ νῦν οἶδα ὅτι ὁ Θεός δώσει σοι ὅσα ἂν αἰτήσῃ τὸν Θεὸν
verses.transliteration: alla kai nyn oida hoti ho Theos dōsei soi hosa an aitēsē ton Theon
verses.literal: But . . . even now I know that - God will give You whatever . . . You ask of - [Him]

verses.original: σου ὁ ἀδελφός Ἀναστήσεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῇ
verses.transliteration: sou ho adelphos Anastēsetai ho Iēsous Legei autē
verses.literal: Your - brother will rise again - Jesus told her -

verses.original: ἡ Μάρθα Λέγει αὐτῷ Οἶδα ὅτι ἀναστήσεται ἐν τῇ ἀναστάσει ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: hē Martha Legei autō Oida hoti anastēsetai en tē anastasei en tē eschatē hēmera
verses.literal: - Martha replied . . . I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπεν αὐτῇ Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ἀνάστασις καὶ ἡ ζωή ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ζήσεται κἂν ἀποθάνῃ
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Eipen autē Egō eimi hē anastasis kai hē zōē ho pisteuōn eis eme zēsetai kan apothanē
verses.literal: - Jesus said to her I am the resurrection and the life Whoever believes in Me will live even though he dies

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὁ ζῶν καὶ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ μὴ ἀποθάνῃ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα πιστεύεις τοῦτο
verses.transliteration: kai pas ho zōn kai pisteuōn eis eme ou mē apothanē eis ton aiōna pisteueis touto
verses.literal: And everyone who lives and believes in Me vvv vvv will never die . . . . . . . . . Do you believe this

verses.original: Ναί Κύριε Λέγει αὐτῷ ἐγὼ πεπίστευκα ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἐρχόμενος εἰς τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: Nai Kyrie Legei autō egō pepisteuka hoti sy ei ho Christos ho Huios tou Theou ho erchomenos eis ton kosmon
verses.literal: Yes Lord she answered . . . I believe that You are the Christ the Son - of God who was to come into the world

verses.original: Καὶ εἰποῦσα τοῦτο ἀπῆλθεν καὶ ἐφώνησεν αὐτῆς τὴν ἀδελφὴν Μαριὰμ λάθρᾳ εἰποῦσα Ὁ Διδάσκαλος πάρεστιν καὶ φωνεῖ σε
verses.transliteration: Kai eipousa touto apēlthen kai ephōnēsen autēs tēn adelphēn Mariam lathra eipousa Ho Didaskalos parestin kai phōnei se
verses.literal: [After] [Martha] had said this she went back and called her - sister Mary aside to tell her The Teacher is here and is asking for you

verses.original: δὲ ὡς ἤκουσεν ἐκείνη ἠγέρθη ταχὺ καὶ ἤρχετο πρὸς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de hōs ēkousen ekeinē ēgerthē tachy kai ērcheto pros auton
verses.literal: And when [Mary] heard this she got up quickly and went to Him

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὔπω ἐληλύθει εἰς τὴν κώμην ἀλλ’ ἦν ἔτι ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ὅπου ἡ Μάρθα ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: de ho Iēsous Oupō elēlythei eis tēn kōmēn all’ ēn eti en tō topō hopou hē Martha hypēntēsen autō
verses.literal: Now - Jesus {had} not yet entered . . . the village but was still at the place where - Martha had met Him

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι οἱ ὄντες ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ παραμυθούμενοι αὐτήν μετ’ αὐτῆς ἰδόντες ταχέως ὅτι τὴν Μαριὰμ ἀνέστη καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῇ δόξαντες ὅτι ὑπάγει εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον ἵνα κλαύσῃ ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi hoi ontes en tē oikia kai paramythoumenoi autēn met’ autēs idontes tacheōs hoti tēn Mariam anestē kai exēlthen ēkolouthēsan autē doxantes hoti hypagei eis to mnēmeion hina klausē ekei
verses.literal: [When] the Jews who were in the house - consoling - - [Mary] saw how quickly - - [she] got up and went out they followed her supposing - she was going to the tomb to mourn there

verses.original: οὖν ὡς ἡ Μαριὰμ ἦλθεν ὅπου Ἰησοῦς ἦν ἰδοῦσα αὐτὸν ἔπεσεν πρὸς αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας λέγουσα αὐτῷ Κύριε εἰ ἦς ὧδε μου ὁ ἀδελφός ἄν οὐκ ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: oun hōs hē Mariam ēlthen hopou Iēsous ēn idousa auton epesen pros autou tous podas legousa autō Kyrie ei ēs hōde mou ho adelphos an ouk apethanen
verses.literal: - When - Mary came to - Jesus - [and] saw Him she fell at His - feet [and] said - Lord if You had been here my - brother {would} not have died

verses.original: οὖν ὡς Ἰησοῦς εἶδεν αὐτὴν κλαίουσαν καὶ τοὺς Ἰουδαίους συνελθόντας αὐτῇ κλαίοντας ἐνεβριμήσατο τῷ πνεύματι καὶ ἑαυτόν ἐτάραξεν
verses.transliteration: oun hōs Iēsous eiden autēn klaiousan kai tous Ioudaious synelthontas autē klaiontas enebrimēsato tō pneumati kai heauton etaraxen
verses.literal: - When Jesus saw her weeping and the Jews who had come with her {also} weeping He was deeply moved - in spirit and - troubled

verses.original: Ποῦ τεθείκατε αὐτόν καὶ εἶπεν ἔρχου καὶ ἴδε Κύριε Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Pou tetheikate auton kai eipen erchou kai ide Kyrie Legousin autō
verses.literal: Where have you put him - He asked Come and see Lord they answered . . .

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐδάκρυσεν
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Edakrysen
verses.literal: - Jesus wept

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Ἔλεγον Ἴδε πῶς ἐφίλει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi Elegon Ide pōs ephilei auton
verses.literal: Then the Jews said See how He loved him

verses.original: δὲ Τινὲς ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶπαν ἐδύνατο Οὐκ οὗτος ὁ ἀνοίξας τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ τυφλοῦ καὶ ποιῆσαι μὴ ἵνα οὗτος ἀποθάνῃ
verses.transliteration: de Tines ex autōn eipan edynato Ouk houtos ho anoixas tous ophthalmous tou typhlou kai poiēsai mē hina houtos apothanē
verses.literal: But some of them asked Could not this [man] who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept . . . - [Lazarus] from dying

verses.original: οὖν Ἰησοῦς πάλιν ἐμβριμώμενος ἐν ἑαυτῷ ἔρχεται εἰς τὸ μνημεῖον δὲ ἦν σπήλαιον καὶ λίθος ἐπέκειτο ἐπ’ αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: oun Iēsous palin embrimōmenos en heautō erchetai eis to mnēmeion de ēn spēlaion kai lithos epekeito ep’ autō
verses.literal: - Jesus once again deeply moved . . . . . . came to the tomb - It was a cave [with] a stone laid across [the entrance]

verses.original: Ἄρατε τὸν λίθον ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει Κύριε ἤδη ὄζει Λέγει αὐτῷ Μάρθα ἡ ἀδελφὴ τοῦ τετελευτηκότος γάρ ἐστιν τεταρταῖος
verses.transliteration: Arate ton lithon ho Iēsous legei Kyrie ēdē ozei Legei autō Martha hē adelphē tou teteleutēkotos gar estin tetartaios
verses.literal: Take away the stone - Jesus said Lord by now he stinks said - Martha the sister of the dead [man] - It has already been four days

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῇ Οὐκ εἶπόν σοι ὅτι ἐὰν πιστεύσῃς ὄψῃ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autē Ouk eipon soi hoti ean pisteusēs opsē tēn doxan tou Theou
verses.literal: - Jesus replied . . . vvv Did I not tell you that if you believed you would see the glory - of God

verses.original: οὖν Ἦραν τὸν λίθον δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἦρεν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἄνω καὶ εἶπεν Πάτερ εὐχαριστῶ σοι ὅτι ἤκουσάς μου
verses.transliteration: oun Ēran ton lithon de ho Iēsous ēren tous ophthalmous anō kai eipen Pater eucharistō soi hoti ēkousas mou
verses.literal: So they took away the stone Then - Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said Father I thank You that You have heard Me

verses.original: δὲ ἐγὼ ᾔδειν ὅτι πάντοτέ ἀκούεις μου ἀλλὰ εἶπον διὰ τὸν ὄχλον τὸν περιεστῶτα ἵνα πιστεύσωσιν ὅτι σύ ἀπέστειλας με
verses.transliteration: de egō ēdein hoti pantote akoueis mou alla eipon dia ton ochlon ton periestōta hina pisteusōsin hoti sy apesteilas me
verses.literal: - I knew that vvv You always hear Me but I say [this] for the benefit of the people - standing [here] so they may believe that You sent Me

verses.original: Καὶ εἰπὼν ταῦτα ἐκραύγασεν μεγάλῃ φωνῇ Λάζαρε δεῦρο ἔξω
verses.transliteration: Kai eipōn tauta ekraugasen megalē phōnē Lazare deuro exō
verses.literal: - [After Jesus] had said this He called out vvv in a loud voice Lazarus come out

verses.original: ὁ τεθνηκὼς ἐξῆλθεν τοὺς τὰς χεῖρας καὶ πόδας δεδεμένος κειρίαις καὶ αὐτοῦ ἡ ὄψις περιεδέδετο σουδαρίῳ Λύσατε αὐτὸν καὶ ἄφετε αὐτὸν ὑπάγειν Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ
verses.transliteration: ho tethnēkōs exēlthen tous tas cheiras kai podas dedemenos keiriais kai autou hē opsis periededeto soudariō Lysate auton kai aphete auton hypagein Iēsous Legei autois ho
verses.literal: The [man who] had been dead came out [with his] - hands and feet bound in strips of linen and his - face wrapped in a cloth Unwrap him and let him go Jesus told them -

verses.original: οὖν Πολλοὶ ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων οἱ ἐλθόντες πρὸς τὴν Μαριὰμ καὶ θεασάμενοι ἃ ἐποίησεν ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun Polloi ek tōn Ioudaiōn hoi elthontes pros tēn Mariam kai theasamenoi ha epoiēsen episteusan eis auton
verses.literal: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to - Mary and had seen what [Jesus] did believed in Him

verses.original: δὲ τινὲς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπῆλθον πρὸς τοὺς Φαρισαίους καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς ἃ Ἰησοῦς ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: de tines ex autōn apēlthon pros tous Pharisaious kai eipan autois ha Iēsous epoiēsen
verses.literal: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done

verses.original: οὖν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι Συνήγαγον συνέδριον καὶ ἔλεγον Τί ποιοῦμεν ὅτι οὗτος ὁ ἄνθρωπος ποιεῖ πολλὰ σημεῖα
verses.transliteration: oun hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi Synēgagon synedrion kai elegon Ti poioumen hoti houtos ho anthrōpos poiei polla sēmeia
verses.literal: Then the chief priests and - Pharisees convened the Sanhedrin and said What are we to do - This - man is performing many signs

verses.original: ἐὰν ἀφῶμεν αὐτὸν οὕτως πάντες πιστεύσουσιν εἰς αὐτόν καὶ οἱ Ῥωμαῖοι ἐλεύσονται καὶ ἀροῦσιν καὶ ἡμῶν τὸν τόπον καὶ τὸ ἔθνος
verses.transliteration: ean aphōmen auton houtōs pantes pisteusousin eis auton kai hoi Rhōmaioi eleusontai kai arousin kai hēmōn ton topon kai to ethnos
verses.literal: If we let Him go on like this everyone will believe in Him and then the Romans will come and take away both our - place and [our] nation

verses.original: δέ τις Εἷς ἐξ αὐτῶν Καϊάφας ὢν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐκείνου ἐνιαυτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς οἴδατε οὐκ οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: de tis Heis ex autōn Kaiaphas ōn archiereus tou ekeinou eniautou eipen autois Hymeis oidate ouk ouden
verses.literal: But vvv one of them [named] Caiaphas who was high priest - that year said to them You know vvv nothing at all

verses.original: οὐδὲ λογίζεσθε ὅτι συμφέρει ὑμῖν ἵνα εἷς ἄνθρωπος ἀποθάνῃ ὑπὲρ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ τὸ ὅλον ἔθνος μὴ ἀπόληται
verses.transliteration: oude logizesthe hoti sympherei hymin hina heis anthrōpos apothanē hyper tou laou kai to holon ethnos mē apolētai
verses.literal: vvv You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people [than that] the whole nation vvv perish

verses.original: δὲ οὐκ εἶπεν Τοῦτο ἀφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλὰ ὢν ἀρχιερεὺς τοῦ ἐκείνου ἐνιαυτοῦ ἐπροφήτευσεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἔμελλεν ἀποθνήσκειν ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἔθνους
verses.transliteration: de ouk eipen Touto aph’ heautou alla ōn archiereus tou ekeinou eniautou eprophēteusen hoti Iēsous emellen apothnēskein hyper tou ethnous
verses.literal: - vvv [Caiaphas] did not say this on his own Instead [as] high priest - that year he was prophesying that Jesus would die for the nation

verses.original: καὶ οὐχ μόνον ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἔθνους ἀλλ’ καὶ ἵνα τὰ τὰ διεσκορπισμένα τέκνα τοῦ Θεοῦ συναγάγῃ εἰς ἕν
verses.transliteration: kai ouch monon hyper tou ethnous all’ kai hina ta ta dieskorpismena tekna tou Theou synagagē eis hen
verses.literal: and not only for the nation but also [for] the - scattered children - of God to gather [them] together into one

verses.original: οὖν Ἀπ’ ἐκείνης τῆς ἡμέρας ἐβουλεύσαντο ἵνα ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun Ap’ ekeinēs tēs hēmeras ebouleusanto hina apokteinōsin auton
verses.literal: So from that - day {on} they plotted to kill Him

verses.original: οὖν Ὁ Ἰησοῦς οὐκέτι περιεπάτει παρρησίᾳ ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ἀλλὰ ἀπῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς πόλιν λεγομένην Ἐφραὶμ εἰς τὴν χώραν ἐγγὺς τῆς ἐρήμου ἔμεινεν κἀκεῖ μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν
verses.transliteration: oun HO Iēsous ouketi periepatei parrēsia en tois Ioudaiois alla apēlthen ekeithen eis polin legomenēn Ephraim eis tēn chōran engys tēs erēmou emeinen kakei meta tōn mathētōn
verses.literal: As a result - Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews but He withdrew . . . to a town called Ephraim in - an area near the wilderness [And] He stayed there with the disciples

verses.original: δὲ τὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων πάσχα Ἦν ἐγγὺς καὶ πολλοὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐκ τῆς χώρας εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ἵνα ἁγνίσωσιν ἑαυτούς πρὸ τοῦ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: de to tōn Ioudaiōn pascha Ēn engys kai polloi anebēsan ek tēs chōras eis Hierosolyma hina hagnisōsin heautous pro tou pascha
verses.literal: Now the vvv Jewish Passover was near and many [people] went up from the country to Jerusalem to purify themselves before the Passover

verses.original: οὖν ἐζήτουν τὸν Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἔλεγον μετ’ ἀλλήλων ἑστηκότες ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ Τί δοκεῖ ὑμῖν ὅτι μὴ ἔλθῃ εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν οὐ
verses.transliteration: oun ezētoun ton Iēsoun kai elegon met’ allēlōn hestēkotes en tō hierō Ti dokei hymin hoti mē elthē eis tēn heortēn ou
verses.literal: - They kept looking for - Jesus and asking vvv one another [as] they stood in the temple [courts] What do you think . . . - vvv Will He come to the feast at all

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι δεδώκεισαν ἐντολὰς ἵνα ἐάν τις γνῷ ποῦ ἐστιν μηνύσῃ ὅπως πιάσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: de hoi archiereis kai hoi Pharisaioi dedōkeisan entolas hina ean tis gnō pou estin mēnysē hopōs piasōsin auton
verses.literal: But the chief priests and - Pharisees had given orders that - anyone [who] knew where He was must report [it] so that they could arrest Him
